title: 富兰克林邓普顿Larry：油价高企，美国消费出现分化信号
speaker: Larry Hathaway

segments.en: for the rate hikes. Larry, just your thoughts on the energy market overlay, let's call it average of $9,100 in oil this year.
segments.zh: 关于加息。拉里，请谈谈能源市场的影响，今年油价平均按每桶90到100美元来算。

segments.en: That's just top of my head. When does this start to buy?
segments.zh: 这只是我初步的想法。什么时候开始产生影响？

segments.en: Has it started to buy? And do we have a broader issue as we go into 2027 because of high oil prices?
segments.zh: 已经开始产生影响了吗？进入2027年，高油价会不会带来更广泛的问题？

segments.en: Well, I think it's biting in the sense of consumer sentiment, which has been, of course, quite depressed.
segments.zh: 我认为它正在影响消费者信心，而消费者信心当然一直相当低迷。

segments.en: And that's, of course, from being reflected as well in kind of the political discussions leading up to the midterms.
segments.zh: 这当然也反映在中期选举前的政治讨论中。

segments.en: But in terms of spending power, one has to remember that we've got about two thirds or close to two thirds of US consumer spending that's accounted for
segments.zh: 但就购买力而言，必须记住，美国消费者支出中约有三分之二或接近三分之二来自

segments.en: by the top couple of quintiles of Americans by income who are also the biggest beneficiaries of the wealth gains that we've seen
segments.zh: 收入最高的两个五分位群体，他们也是我们从资本市场看到的财富增长的最大受益者。

segments.en: through capital markets. So from that perspective, we're not seeing it show up yet in any kind of significant slowdown of household spending,
segments.zh: 因此从这个角度看，我们尚未看到家庭支出出现任何显著放缓，

segments.en: the Fed characterize household spending or consumption as resilient, and that is correct.
segments.zh: 美联储将家庭支出或消费描述为有韧性，这是正确的。

segments.en: But I think there is some bifurcation that's likely to take place with some loss in purchasing power due to higher energy prices as you cited amongst lower income
segments.zh: 但我认为可能会出现一些分化，正如你提到的，能源价格上涨会导致低收入群体购买力有所下降。

segments.en: Americans who are also going to be a little bit more strapped now in terms of financing costs going forward.
segments.zh: 美国人未来的融资成本也会更紧张一些。

segments.en: So I think, well, it's not a full fledged, let's say, K-shaped consumer story in the United States.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，这还不是美国消费者完全K型分化的故事。

segments.en: I do think at the margin, we're going to see some bifurcation and spending patterns in the US as a result of these things.
segments.zh: 我确实认为，边际上我们会看到美国支出模式出现一些分化。
